# Atharv Mantri

## Core Technical Stack
- **Languages & Frameworks**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React 19, Next.js 15, FastAPI, Node.js, HTML5, CSS3/Tailwind.
- **AI & Agent Systems**: Google Gemini API, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Tool-Calling Pipelines, On-Device Machine Learning, Prompt Chains.
- **Cryptographic & Systems Engineering**: Compact ZK (Zero-Knowledge Proofs / Groth16 circuits on Midnight Network), Docker, Linux ops, Web Automation (Playwright), Firebase, PostgreSQL.

## Paid Micro-Sprints
- **Lower-friction paid entry**: One bounded diagnosis of a reproducible bug, UI issue, or QA concern, up to 45 minutes, producing a written finding/reproduction/checklist rather than an unlimited fix.
- **Diagnosis indicative range**: INR 750–1,500, agreed only after the written scope, acceptance check, and payout terms are clear.
- **Offer**: One bounded 2–4 hour React/TypeScript frontend fix, small frontend section, or QA pass.
- **Indicative range**: INR 2,500–5,000, agreed only after the written scope, acceptance check, and payout terms are clear.
- **Handoff**: Exact files changed, browser/mobile checks, known limitations, and a concise delivery note.
- **Guardrails**: No unpaid trial; guardian consent is required because Atharv is 15; no production credentials or client data before authorized written engagement.
- **Proof**: [paid diagnosis sample](https://atharv.me/demos/paid-diagnosis-sample.html), [business-group](https://atharv.me/demos/business-group-starter.html), [hospitality](https://atharv.me/demos/hospitality-starter.html), [local-service](https://atharv.me/demos/service-enquiry-starter.html), [event-venue](https://atharv.me/demos/venue-starter.html), and [private agency overflow](https://atharv.me/demos/agency-overflow.html) samples.
- **Request**: [Send a paid micro-sprint brief](mailto:work@atharv.me?subject=Paid%20micro-sprint%20brief).

## Highlighted Projects

- **[ScopeSignal brief analyzer](https://scopesignal.vercel.app/?demo=1)**: local-first browser tool that turns a rough software brief into likely deliverables, acceptance checks, missing decisions, risk signals, and a suggested first paid slice. It does not upload the brief or call an AI model at runtime. The [brief-to-first-slice guide](https://atharv.me/demos/brief-to-first-slice.html) explains the handoff pattern.
- **[ActionPath](https://actionpath.atharv.me)**: AI-powered executive-function tool converting educational communications (emails, syllabi, LMS notices, PDFs) into actionable 7-day checklists and start cues using a 7-stage Gemini pipeline. [GitHub](https://github.com/atharvmantri/ActionPath)
- **[Lumi Assist](https://lumiassist.xyz)**: Local-first Windows 11 voice assistant with wake-word activation, 260+ system automation tools, and streaming local TTS. [GitHub](https://github.com/atharvmantri/Lumi-Assist)
- **[BridgeMind](https://github.com/atharvmantri/BridgeMind)**: Chrome extension and multi-agent accessibility engine adapting dense web content to diverse cognitive profiles. STEMINATE Hackathon finalist.
- **[ScribeMesh](https://github.com/atharvmantri/ScribeMesh)**: Video-to-documentation platform generating timestamped hardware component notes and structured maintenance catalogues via Gemini 2.5.
- **[ShadowKey](https://github.com/atharvmantri/ShadowKey)**: Zero-knowledge identity verification platform running 9 Groth16 circuits written in Compact on the Midnight Network.
- **[Guardnet](https://github.com/atharvmantri/Guardnet)**: Real-time disaster risk intelligence PWA aggregating NASA, USGS, GDACS, and weather telemetry. Built for WeatherWise 2026.
- **[Websniper](https://github.com/atharvmantri/Websniper)**: Local visual web scraper builder with automated selector repair and Playwright timeline execution.
- **[Cognitive](https://github.com/atharvmantri/Cognitive)**: Local-first attention operating system using on-device ML for overload detection and interruption filtering.
